## Highlights

- Verifies human Swarm Chat and Bot-to-Bot messages reuse one durable participant conversation per Bot and Swarm.
- Documents the shared Swarm board, private Bot execution contexts, routines, subagents, scratchpads, and user escalation flow.

Protocol 62, configuration 23, chat specification 14, checkpoint 13, SQLite schema 9, Bot state 4, and Swarm state v4 are unchanged from 0.11.0.
